add_pointclouds_to_volumes: add a batch of Pointclouds to existing Volumes using trilinear or nearest neighbor splatting mode
add_points_features_to_volume_densities_: convert 3D point cloud coordinates and features tensors into volume density and feature tensors
splat_points_to_volumes: splat 3D points into volumes using trilinear interpolation with weighted votes to the 8-neighborhood
round_points_to_volumes: round 3D points to nearest voxel coordinates and average features that fall into each voxel
points_to_volumes_function: run the differentiable autograd function that adds point weights to volume densities and features in place
